g.text: Shiny 1.8: everyone takes turns behind one lock
Shiny 1.9: each session runs on its own, at the same time
All six outputs run at the same time.
While one output waits for its query,
the others keep going, in every session.
Each session keeps its own order.
A session sends its outputs together,
and applies the next input only after
that, so inputs never change halfway
